summary: CMS Energy filed an 8-K announcing the commencement of an at-the-market equity offering program under which up to $3 billion of its common stock may be sold from time to time via forward sale agreements with multiple banks. The filing updates an existing prospectus supplement and includes an agreement with forward purchasers and agents. No specific terms (price, discount, close date) are stated. This is a routine shelf takedown and ATM program, not a transformative special situation. There is no defined risk-arb angle; it is a capital markets funding transaction.
